behaviour: Restores the element `pageId` and the AppState page keys, repairing invalid page data deterministically.
rules: `restorePages` and `restoreActivePageId` are added to the existing `@excalidraw/element` import that holds `syncInvalidIndices`; `PageViewport` is added to the `@excalidraw/element/types` type import.

In `restoreElementWithProperties`, after the legacy-prop deletes: when `typeof ret.pageId !== "string"` or it is empty, `delete` it from `ret` (through a `Mutable` cast), so a missing or malformed page id is left for the page repair step.

In `restoreAppState`, after `fontTopPicks` is restored, normalize the values the generic loop already picked (supplied, else local, else default): `pages = restorePages(nextAppState.pages)`, `activePageId = restoreActivePageId(pages, nextAppState.activePageId)`; `pageViewports` keeps only entries of `nextAppState.pageViewports` whose key is the id of a page in `pages` other than `activePageId` and whose `scrollX`, `scrollY` and `zoom` are finite numbers, with `zoom` passed through `getNormalizedZoom`; a non-object `pageViewports` yields `{}`.
The three values are assigned onto `nextAppState` so the returned object carries them.

sites.rule: Add `restoreActivePageId` and `restorePages` to this import list.
Add `PageViewport,` to the type import list.
Drop a non-string or empty `pageId` per the rules.
Restore pages, activePageId and pageViewports per the rules, with a short comment.

behaviour: Loads a scene file onto its pages: repairs element page membership and scrolls to the active page's content.
rules: Import `getPageElements`, `repairElementPages`, `restoreActivePageId` and `restorePages` from `@excalidraw/element` in a new import statement before the `@excalidraw/element/renderEnvironment` import.

In `loadSceneOrLibraryFromBlob`, for valid excalidraw data: compute `pages = restorePages(data.appState?.pages)` and `activePageId = restoreActivePageId(pages, data.appState?.activePageId)`, then `elements = repairElementPages(restoreElements(...same args...), pages, activePageId)`.
`getScrollToContentState` receives `getPageElements(elements, activePageId)` instead of all elements.

The object passed to `restoreAppState` sets `pages` and `activePageId` right after the `...cleanAppStateForExport(data.appState || {})` spread (and `pageViewports: data.appState?.pageViewports ?? {}`), so a legacy file never inherits the local pages.

sites.rule: Insert the import of the four page helpers, sorted alphabetically.
Compute pages, activePageId and the repaired elements per the rules.

behaviour: Saves every page's elements when writing a `.excalidraw` JSON file.
rules: In `actionSaveToActiveFile`, when `previousFileHandle` is not an image file handle the data passed to `prepareDataForJSONExport` uses `app.scene.getAllPagesElementsIncludingDeleted()`; for an image file handle it keeps the action's `elements` (the active page), since an image export holds one page.
The `appState` passed is unchanged (it already holds pages, activePageId and pageViewports).
